description:
Image alt-text quality: replace Wikimedia filenames with real descriptions, then re-localize

## Problem

`static/data/image-alt-text/en-US.json` (2086 entries, consumed by `src/lib/image-alt.ts` → `getImageAlt`) is auto-generated from `image-provenance.json` caption/title fields by `scripts/build-image-alt-baseline.ts`. **~754 of 2086 entries (36%) are raw Wikimedia filenames**, e.g. `"File:Beidou satellite mockup at FING UNLP 03.jpg"` — not descriptive alt-text. Screen-reader users hear a filename instead of a description.

This surfaced while doing the **localization** pass (option A): we wired the runtime for per-locale alt-text (`loadLocaleAltText` in `image-alt.ts`, registered from the root layout) and translated the **~1332 real captions** into all 13 non-en-US locales (`scripts/translate-alt-text.mjs`), deliberately **skipping the 754 filenames** (translating a filename is pointless — they fall back to en-US). So the quality gap is now the blocker to full localization.

## Fix (option C)

Regenerate real alt-text from actual descriptions rather than filenames:
- Prefer `image-vision.json` subject/description (vision-scored) or the provenance `description`/caption over the raw `title`/filename in `build-image-alt-baseline.ts`.
- For entries with no good description, synthesize a short factual alt-text (agency + subject) rather than emitting the filename.
- Add a validator/audit that flags `File:`-style / bare-`.jpg` alt-text as a quality gap.

## Then re-localize (B/A follow-up)

Once en-US alt-text is real descriptions, re-run `scripts/translate-alt-text.mjs` (drop the filename skip → full coverage, option B) so all 14 locales carry real, translated alt-text.

## References
- `src/lib/image-alt.ts` (accessor + `loadLocaleAltText`)
- `scripts/build-image-alt-baseline.ts` (en-US baseline)
- `scripts/translate-alt-text.mjs` (localization, option A)
- Only current consumer: `src/lib/components/SiteStoryPanel.svelte`
